## ROCMICS

Teneille's data analysis repository is available at <https://github.com/Teneille97/rocmics>.

## Aggregate stability tests

**ERW can influence aggregation via:**

- Cation bridging
- Microbial EPS production
- Secondary mineral formation, e.g. amorphous sesquioxides and silicates
- Salt-induced flocculation

## Treatment effect

The mean weight diameter (MWD) was calculated by multiplying the proportion of aggregates in each size class by the midpoint diameter of that class and summing across size classes. The geometric mean diameter (GMD) was calculated using a logarithmic weighting of the aggregate size classes. The fractal dimension (D) was calculated from the slope of the relationship between log cumulative aggregate mass and log normalized sieve diameter.

Treatment differences in MWD, GMD and D were assessed separately within each extract using **Welch's one-way ANOVA followed by Games–Howell pairwise comparisons**. This approach allows for unequal variances among treatments. Compact letter displays were used to identify statistically distinguishable groups.

The H₂O extract represents the baseline aggregate stability measurement. Comparisons of MWD, GMD and D between treatments under H₂O extraction were used to assess treatment effects on aggregate stability.

## Extract effect

Extract effects were assessed separately for each treatment and aggregate stability metric (MWD, GMD and D). **Welch's one-way ANOVA followed by Games–Howell pairwise comparisons** was used to compare aggregate stability between extracts within each treatment.

Oxalate extraction targets acid-soluble and poorly crystalline Fe and Al phases; H₂O₂ extraction oxidizes soil organic matter; and NaOH extraction targets additional mineral-associated and siliceous components. Changes in aggregate stability following these extractions provide an indication of the potential contribution of these components to aggregation.

Oxalate:H₂O ratios were calculated for MWD, GMD and D using matched sample, replicate and treatment observations. These ratios express the aggregate stability index following oxalate extraction relative to the H₂O baseline. A ratio of 1 indicates no change, ratios below 1 indicate a decrease, and ratios above 1 indicate an increase following oxalate extraction.

Treatment differences in the oxalate:H₂O ratios were assessed separately for GMD, D and MWD using Welch's one-way ANOVA followed by Games–Howell pairwise comparisons.

# ==============================================================================
# FRACTAL DIMENSION CALCULATION
# ==============================================================================

calc_fractal_D <- function(
    f_gt2,
    f_gt025,
    f_gt0063,
    f_lt0063
) {

  # Cumulative mass finer than sieve size
  cum_mass <- c(
    f_lt0063,
    f_lt0063 + f_gt0063,
    f_lt0063 + f_gt0063 + f_gt025
  )

  R <- c(0.063, 0.25, 2)

  fit <- lm(
    log(cum_mass) ~ log(R / max(R))
  )

  slope <- coef(fit)[2]

  D <- 3 - slope

  return(as.numeric(D))
}

# ==============================================================================
# DATA CLEANING AND AGGREGATE STABILITY CALCULATIONS
# ==============================================================================

clean_aggstab_extract <- function(filename, extract_label) {

  # Import data
  df <- read.csv(
    here("csv_files", filename),
    header = TRUE
  )

  # Add treatment names
  df$treatment <- tmt_names_vec

  # Convert to factors
  df[c("extract", "rep", "treatment")] <-
    lapply(
      df[c("extract", "rep", "treatment")],
      as.factor
    )

  # Select columns
  df <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(
      sample,
      extract,
      rep,
      recovery....,
      X...2mm.fraction,
      X...0.25mm.fraction,
      X...0.063mm.fraction,
      X...0.063mm.fraction.1,
      treatment
    )

  # Rename columns
  df <- df %>%
    rename(
      recovery = recovery....,
      `>2mm.fraction` = X...2mm.fraction,
      `>0.25mm.fraction` = X...0.25mm.fraction,
      `>0.063mm.fraction` = X...0.063mm.fraction,
      `<0.063mm.fraction` = X...0.063mm.fraction.1
    )

  # Remove missing rows
  df <- df %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(`>2mm.fraction`),
      !is.na(`>0.25mm.fraction`),
      !is.na(`>0.063mm.fraction`),
      !is.na(`<0.063mm.fraction`)
    )

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Aggregate metrics
  # Fractions are percentages and are converted to proportions
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  df <- df %>%
    mutate(

      # Mean Weight Diameter
      MWD =
        (`>0.25mm.fraction` / 100) * 1.125 +
        (`>0.063mm.fraction` / 100) * 0.1565 +
        (`<0.063mm.fraction` / 100) * 0.0315,

      # Geometric Mean Diameter
      GMD = exp(
        (`>0.25mm.fraction` / 100) * log(1.125) +
          (`>0.063mm.fraction` / 100) * log(0.1565) +
          (`<0.063mm.fraction` / 100) * log(0.0315)
      )
    )

  # Fractal dimension
  df$D <- mapply(
    calc_fractal_D,
    df$`>2mm.fraction`,
    df$`>0.25mm.fraction`,
    df$`>0.063mm.fraction`,
    df$`<0.063mm.fraction`
  )

  # Pivot to long format
  df_long <- df %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = c(
        `>2mm.fraction`,
        `>0.25mm.fraction`,
        `>0.063mm.fraction`,
        `<0.063mm.fraction`
      ),
      names_to = "fraction_type",
      values_to = "fraction"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      fraction_type = case_when(
        fraction_type == ">2mm.fraction" ~ ">2",
        fraction_type == ">0.25mm.fraction" ~ ">0.25",
        fraction_type == ">0.063mm.fraction" ~ ">0.063",
        fraction_type == "<0.063mm.fraction" ~ "<0.063"
      ),

      fraction_type = factor(
        fraction_type,
        levels = c(">2", ">0.25", ">0.063", "<0.063")
      ),

      extract_type = factor(
        extract_label,
        levels = c("h2o", "oxalate", "h2o2", "naoh")
      )
    )

  return(as.data.frame(df_long))
}

# ==============================================================================
# GAMES-HOWELL COMPACT LETTER DISPLAY FUNCTION
# Handles NA and non-finite adjusted p-values
# ==============================================================================

make_games_howell_letters <- function(
    gh_results,
    group_levels
) {

  # Initialize matrix of adjusted p-values
  p_matrix <- matrix(
    1,
    nrow = length(group_levels),
    ncol = length(group_levels),
    dimnames = list(
      group_levels,
      group_levels
    )
  )

  # Fill matrix with Games-Howell adjusted p-values
  if (nrow(gh_results) > 0) {

    for (i in seq_len(nrow(gh_results))) {

      group1 <- as.character(gh_results$group1[i])
      group2 <- as.character(gh_results$group2[i])

      p_adj <- suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(gh_results$p.adj[i])
      )

      # Replace undefined p-values with 1
      if (!is.finite(p_adj)) {
        p_adj <- 1
      }

      # Ensure p-value is within valid bounds
      p_adj <- min(
        max(p_adj, 0),
        1
      )

      # Populate matrix only for valid group names
      if (
        group1 %in% group_levels &&
        group2 %in% group_levels
      ) {

        p_matrix[group1, group2] <- p_adj
        p_matrix[group2, group1] <- p_adj

      }
    }
  }

  # Ensure matrix contains no NA values
  p_matrix[is.na(p_matrix)] <- 1

  # Set diagonal
  diag(p_matrix) <- 1

  # Generate compact letter display
  cld_results <- multcompView::multcompLetters(
    p_matrix,
    Letters = letters
  )$Letters

  tibble::tibble(
    group = names(cld_results),
    .group = unname(cld_results)
  )
}
# ==============================================================================
# ANALYSIS FUNCTION:
# COMPARE TREATMENTS WITHIN EACH EXTRACT
# WELCH ANOVA + GAMES-HOWELL
# ==============================================================================

analyze_metric_by_extract <- function(
    df,
    metric = "MWD",
    ylab = metric
) {

  results_list <- list()
  plots_list <- list()
  overall_results_list <- list()
  pairwise_results_list <- list()
  letters_results_list <- list()

  for (xtract in unique(df$extract_type)) {

    metric_df <- df %>%
      filter(extract_type == xtract) %>%
      filter(
        !is.na(.data[[metric]]),
        !is.na(treatment)
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        treatment = droplevels(as.factor(treatment)),
        response = .data[[metric]]
      )

    group_levels <- levels(metric_df$treatment)

    # Require at least two groups with sufficient replication
    if (
      length(group_levels) < 2 ||
      any(table(metric_df$treatment) < 2)
    ) {

      warning(
        "Insufficient replication for metric ",
        metric,
        " in extract ",
        xtract
      )

      next
    }

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Welch ANOVA
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    welch_result <- stats::oneway.test(
      response ~ treatment,
      data = metric_df,
      var.equal = FALSE
    )

    overall_results_list[[as.character(xtract)]] <-
      tibble(
        metric = metric,
        extract_type = as.character(xtract),
        test = "Welch ANOVA",
        p_overall = welch_result$p.value
      )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Games-Howell pairwise comparisons
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    gh_result <- rstatix::games_howell_test(
      metric_df,
      response ~ treatment
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        metric = metric,
        extract_type = as.character(xtract)
      )

    pairwise_results_list[[as.character(xtract)]] <-
      gh_result

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Compact letter display
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    letters_df <- make_games_howell_letters(
      gh_result,
      group_levels
    ) %>%
      rename(
        treatment = group
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        extract_type = as.character(xtract),
        metric = metric
      )

    letters_results_list[[as.character(xtract)]] <-
      letters_df

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Summary statistics
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    summary_df <- metric_df %>%
      group_by(treatment) %>%
      summarise(
        mean_value = mean(response, na.rm = TRUE),
        se_value = sd(response, na.rm = TRUE) /
          sqrt(sum(!is.na(response))),
        n = sum(!is.na(response)),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      left_join(
        letters_df %>%
          dplyr::select(treatment, .group),
        by = "treatment"
      )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Plot
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    p <- ggplot(
      summary_df,
      aes(
        x = treatment,
        y = mean_value,
        fill = treatment
      )
    ) +
      geom_col(width = 0.7) +
      geom_errorbar(
        aes(
          ymin = mean_value - se_value,
          ymax = mean_value + se_value
        ),
        width = 0.2
      ) +
      geom_text(
        aes(
          label = .group,
          y = mean_value + se_value
        ),
        fontface = "bold",
        colour = "black"
      ) +
      scale_fill_viridis_d() +
      labs(
        y = ylab,
        x = NULL,
        title = paste("Extract:", xtract)
      ) +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(
          angle = 45,
          hjust = 1
        )
      )

    results_list[[as.character(xtract)]] <- summary_df
    plots_list[[as.character(xtract)]] <- p

  }

  list(
    results = results_list,
    plots = plots_list,
    overall = bind_rows(overall_results_list),
    pairwise = bind_rows(pairwise_results_list),
    letters = bind_rows(letters_results_list)
  )
}

# ==============================================================================
# ANALYSIS FUNCTION:
# COMPARE EXTRACTS WITHIN EACH TREATMENT
# WELCH ANOVA + GAMES-HOWELL
# ==============================================================================

analyze_metric_by_treatment <- function(
    df,
    metric = "MWD"
) {

  results_list <- list()
  overall_results_list <- list()
  pairwise_results_list <- list()
  letters_results_list <- list()

  for (tmt in unique(df$treatment)) {

    metric_df <- df %>%
      filter(treatment == tmt) %>%
      filter(
        !is.na(.data[[metric]]),
        !is.na(extract_type)
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        extract_type = droplevels(as.factor(extract_type)),
        response = .data[[metric]]
      )

    group_levels <- levels(metric_df$extract_type)

    # Require at least two groups with sufficient replication
    if (
      length(group_levels) < 2 ||
      any(table(metric_df$extract_type) < 2)
    ) {

      warning(
        "Insufficient replication for metric ",
        metric,
        " in treatment ",
        tmt
      )

      next
    }

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Welch ANOVA
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    welch_result <- stats::oneway.test(
      response ~ extract_type,
      data = metric_df,
      var.equal = FALSE
    )

    overall_results_list[[as.character(tmt)]] <-
      tibble(
        metric = metric,
        treatment = as.character(tmt),
        test = "Welch ANOVA",
        p_overall = welch_result$p.value
      )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Games-Howell pairwise comparisons
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    gh_result <- rstatix::games_howell_test(
      metric_df,
      response ~ extract_type
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        metric = metric,
        treatment = as.character(tmt)
      )

    pairwise_results_list[[as.character(tmt)]] <-
      gh_result

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Compact letter display
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    letters_df <- make_games_howell_letters(
      gh_result,
      group_levels
    ) %>%
      rename(
        extract_type = group
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        treatment = as.character(tmt),
        metric = metric
      )

    letters_results_list[[as.character(tmt)]] <-
      letters_df

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Summary statistics
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    summary_df <- metric_df %>%
      group_by(extract_type) %>%
      summarise(
        mean_value = mean(response, na.rm = TRUE),
        se_value = sd(response, na.rm = TRUE) /
          sqrt(sum(!is.na(response))),
        n = sum(!is.na(response)),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      left_join(
        letters_df %>%
          dplyr::select(extract_type, .group),
        by = "extract_type"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        treatment = as.character(tmt),
        metric = metric
      )

    results_list[[as.character(tmt)]] <- summary_df

  }

  list(
    results = results_list,
    overall = bind_rows(overall_results_list),
    pairwise = bind_rows(pairwise_results_list),
    letters = bind_rows(letters_results_list)
  )
}

# ==============================================================================
# IMPORT AND CLEAN AGGREGATE STABILITY DATA
# ==============================================================================

aggstab_h2o <- clean_aggstab_extract(
  "aggstab_2026_h2o.csv",
  "h2o"
)

# Remove faulty sample
aggstab_h2o <- aggstab_h2o %>%
  filter(
    !(sample == 4 &
        rep == "b" &
        treatment == "Bolsdorfer_50")
  )

aggstab_oxalate <- clean_aggstab_extract(
  "aggstab_2026_oxalate.csv",
  "oxalate"
)

aggstab_h2o2 <- clean_aggstab_extract(
  "aggstab_2026_h2o2.csv",
  "h2o2"
)

aggstab_naoh <- clean_aggstab_extract(
  "aggstab_2026_naoh.csv",
  "naoh"
)

# Combine all extracts
aggstab_all <- bind_rows(
  aggstab_h2o,
  aggstab_oxalate,
  aggstab_h2o2,
  aggstab_naoh
)

# Retain unique aggregate stability metrics
aggstab_metrics <- aggstab_all %>%
  distinct(
    sample,
    rep,
    treatment,
    extract_type,
    MWD,
    GMD,
    D
  )

# ==============================================================================
# PAIRED OXALATE:H2O AGGREGATE STABILITY RATIOS
# ==============================================================================

# Calculate ratios using matched sample, replicate and treatment.
# Each oxalate observation is divided by its corresponding H2O observation.

aggstab_ratios <- aggstab_metrics %>%
  filter(
    extract_type %in% c("h2o", "oxalate")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sample,
    rep,
    treatment,
    extract_type,
    MWD,
    GMD,
    D
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = extract_type,
    values_from = c(MWD, GMD, D),
    names_sep = "_"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    MWD_oxalate_over_h2o = MWD_oxalate / MWD_h2o,
    GMD_oxalate_over_h2o = GMD_oxalate / GMD_h2o,
    D_oxalate_over_h2o = D_oxalate / D_h2o
  ) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(MWD_oxalate_over_h2o),
    is.finite(GMD_oxalate_over_h2o),
    is.finite(D_oxalate_over_h2o)
  )

# Export matched ratios
write.csv(
  aggstab_ratios,
  here("outputs", "aggstab_oxalate_over_h2o_ratios.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ==============================================================================
# LONG FORMAT FOR RATIO ANALYSIS
# ==============================================================================

aggstab_ratios_long <- aggstab_ratios %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sample,
    rep,
    treatment,
    GMD_oxalate_over_h2o,
    D_oxalate_over_h2o,
    MWD_oxalate_over_h2o
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      GMD_oxalate_over_h2o,
      D_oxalate_over_h2o,
      MWD_oxalate_over_h2o
    ),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "ratio"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    metric = factor(
      metric,
      levels = c(
        "GMD_oxalate_over_h2o",
        "D_oxalate_over_h2o",
        "MWD_oxalate_over_h2o"
      ),
      labels = c(
        "GMD oxalate:H2O",
        "D oxalate:H2O",
        "MWD oxalate:H2O"
      )
    )
  )

# ==============================================================================
# STATISTICAL COMPARISONS OF OXALATE:H2O RATIOS BETWEEN TREATMENTS
# WELCH ANOVA + GAMES-HOWELL
# ==============================================================================

ratio_overall_results <- list()
ratio_pairwise_results <- list()
ratio_letters_results <- list()

for (metric_name in levels(aggstab_ratios_long$metric)) {

  ratio_df <- aggstab_ratios_long %>%
    filter(metric == metric_name) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(ratio),
      !is.na(treatment)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      treatment = droplevels(as.factor(treatment))
    )

  group_levels <- levels(ratio_df$treatment)

  if (
    length(group_levels) < 2 ||
    any(table(ratio_df$treatment) < 2)
  ) {

    warning(
      "Insufficient replication for ratio metric: ",
      metric_name
    )

    next
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Welch ANOVA
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  welch_ratio <- stats::oneway.test(
    ratio ~ treatment,
    data = ratio_df,
    var.equal = FALSE
  )

  ratio_overall_results[[metric_name]] <-
    tibble(
      metric = metric_name,
      test = "Welch ANOVA",
      p_overall = welch_ratio$p.value
    )

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Games-Howell post-hoc
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  gh_ratio <- rstatix::games_howell_test(
    ratio_df,
    ratio ~ treatment
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      metric = metric_name
    )

  ratio_pairwise_results[[metric_name]] <- gh_ratio

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Compact letter display
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ratio_letters <- make_games_howell_letters(
    gh_ratio,
    group_levels
  ) %>%
    rename(
      treatment = group
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      metric = metric_name
    )

  ratio_letters_results[[metric_name]] <- ratio_letters

}

# Combine statistical results
ratio_overall_results_df <- bind_rows(
  ratio_overall_results
)

ratio_pairwise_results_df <- bind_rows(
  ratio_pairwise_results
)

ratio_letters_results_df <- bind_rows(
  ratio_letters_results
)

# Export statistical results
write.csv(
  ratio_overall_results_df,
  here("outputs", "aggstab_ratio_welch_anova.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  ratio_pairwise_results_df,
  here("outputs", "aggstab_ratio_games_howell.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  ratio_letters_results_df,
  here("outputs", "aggstab_ratio_letters.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ==============================================================================
# SUMMARY DATA FOR OXALATE:H2O RATIO PLOTS
# ==============================================================================

ratio_summary <- aggstab_ratios_long %>%
  group_by(
    treatment,
    metric
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_value = mean(ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_value = sd(ratio, na.rm = TRUE) /
      sqrt(sum(!is.na(ratio))),
    n = sum(!is.na(ratio)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    ratio_letters_results_df,
    by = c("treatment", "metric")
  )

# ==============================================================================
# PLOT: OXALATE:H2O RATIOS FOR GMD, D AND MWD
# ==============================================================================

p_oxalate_h2o_ratios <- ggplot(
  ratio_summary,
  aes(
    x = treatment,
    y = mean_value,
    fill = treatment
  )
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 1,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey40",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_col(
    width = 0.7,
    colour = "grey20"
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_value - se_value,
      ymax = mean_value + se_value
    ),
    width = 0.2,
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = aggstab_ratios_long,
    aes(
      x = treatment,
      y = ratio
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    position = position_jitter(
      width = 0.12,
      height = 0
    ),
    colour = "black",
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = .group,
      y = mean_value + se_value
    ),
    colour = "black",
    fontface = "bold",
    vjust = -0.5,
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis(
    discrete = TRUE,
    option = "D",
    end = 0.9
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ metric,
    scales = "free_y",
    nrow = 1
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Oxalate:H2O aggregate stability ratios",
    subtitle = paste(
      "Ratio = oxalate index / H2O index;",

    axis.text.x = element_text(

    ),
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    )
  )

print(p_oxalate_h2o_ratios)

# Save ratio plot
ggsave(
  filename = here(

# ==============================================================================
# RUN AGGREGATE STABILITY ANALYSES
# ==============================================================================

# Treatment comparisons within each extract
MWD_extract <- analyze_metric_by_extract(
  aggstab_metrics,
  metric = "MWD",
  ylab = "Mean Weight Diameter (mm)"
)

GMD_extract <- analyze_metric_by_extract(
  aggstab_metrics,
  metric = "GMD",
  ylab = "Geometric Mean Diameter (mm)"
)

D_extract <- analyze_metric_by_extract(
  aggstab_metrics,
  metric = "D",
  ylab = "Fractal Dimension (D)"
)

# Extract comparisons within each treatment
MWD_treatment <- analyze_metric_by_treatment(
  aggstab_metrics,
  metric = "MWD"
)

GMD_treatment <- analyze_metric_by_treatment(
  aggstab_metrics,
  metric = "GMD"
)

D_treatment <- analyze_metric_by_treatment(
  aggstab_metrics,
  metric = "D"
)

# ==============================================================================
# EXPORT OVERALL AND PAIRWISE STATISTICAL RESULTS
# ==============================================================================

# Treatment comparisons within extracts
write.csv(
  MWD_extract$overall,
  here("outputs", "aggstab_MWD_treatment_welch.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  MWD_extract$pairwise,
  here("outputs", "aggstab_MWD_treatment_games_howell.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  GMD_extract$overall,
  here("outputs", "aggstab_GMD_treatment_welch.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  GMD_extract$pairwise,
  here("outputs", "aggstab_GMD_treatment_games_howell.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  D_extract$overall,
  here("outputs", "aggstab_D_treatment_welch.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  D_extract$pairwise,
  here("outputs", "aggstab_D_treatment_games_howell.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Extract comparisons within treatments
write.csv(
  MWD_treatment$overall,
  here("outputs", "aggstab_MWD_extract_welch.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  MWD_treatment$pairwise,
  here("outputs", "aggstab_MWD_extract_games_howell.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  GMD_treatment$overall,
  here("outputs", "aggstab_GMD_extract_welch.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  GMD_treatment$pairwise,
  here("outputs", "aggstab_GMD_extract_games_howell.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  D_treatment$overall,
  here("outputs", "aggstab_D_extract_welch.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  D_treatment$pairwise,
  here("outputs", "aggstab_D_extract_games_howell.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ==============================================================================
# H2O-ONLY COMPARISON: MWD, GMD, D
# ==============================================================================

# Compact letters from treatment comparisons within H2O
MWD_letters <- MWD_extract$results$h2o %>%
  dplyr::select(treatment, .group) %>%
  mutate(metric = "MWD")

GMD_letters <- GMD_extract$results$h2o %>%
  dplyr::select(treatment, .group) %>%
  mutate(metric = "GMD")

D_letters <- D_extract$results$h2o %>%
  dplyr::select(treatment, .group) %>%
  mutate(metric = "D")

letters_all <- bind_rows(
  MWD_letters,
  GMD_letters,
  D_letters
)

# Convert H2O metrics to long format
h2o_metrics <- aggstab_metrics %>%
  filter(extract_type == "h2o") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(MWD, GMD, D),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  )

# Summary statistics
h2o_summary <- h2o_metrics %>%
  group_by(treatment, metric) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_value = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) /
      sqrt(sum(!is.na(value))),
    n = sum(!is.na(value)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    letters_all,
    by = c("treatment", "metric")
  )

# H2O-only plot
p_h2o_comparison <- ggplot(
  h2o_summary,
  aes(
    x = treatment,
    y = mean_value,
    fill = treatment
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    width = 0.7,
    colour = "grey20"
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_value - se_value,
      ymax = mean_value + se_value
    ),
    width = 0.2,
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = .group,
      y = mean_value + se_value
    ),
    fontface = "bold",
    colour = "black",
    vjust = -0.5
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ metric,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(
    option = "D",
    end = 0.9
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    )
  )

print(p_h2o_comparison)

ggsave(
  filename = here(
    "outputs",
    "aggstab_h2o_treatment_comparison.png"
  ),
  plot = p_h2o_comparison,
  width = 12,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
